Definition
Source: topping:page-0111 1. ch9:5.2\group curvature-pinching Let $W\to \mathcal M$ have fibre metric $h$ and compatible connection $A(t)$. A smooth function $\Psi :W\to \mathbb R$ is parallel when it is invariant under parallel translation for every time.
